style.styleTitle: Personalised Painted Sleigh Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a magical touch to your Christmas tree with this personalised painted sleigh ceramic bauble. Featuring a charming painted sleigh design, this ceramic Christmas decoration is perfect for creating a warm and festive feel in your home while making a thoughtful keepsake to treasure year after year. Personalise the front of the bauble with a name and add 4 lines of text to the reverse, making it a unique personalised Christmas gift for family, friends or loved ones. Ideal for hanging on the Christmas tree or displaying around the home during the festive season, this personalised ceramic bauble is a beautiful addition to your Christmas décor. Please double-check your personalisation, as your text will appear exactly as entered. This bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. The colour of ribbon may vary. The style of bauble topper may vary. Dimensions(mm): Height: 60 Width: 60 Depth: 60.
